interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signals.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the width of the sidewalk to at least 5-6 feet to provide a clear, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees in a dedicated furniture zone to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing to improve pedestrian visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the existing transverse lines with high-visibility continental or ladder markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours, as none are visible in the frame.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement to ensure a smooth surface for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a dedicated space for bins and utilities while increasing separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Designated Waste Collection Areas
interventions.description: Provide specific pads or zones for trash bins to ensure the narrow sidewalk remains clear for through-movement.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with high-visibility paint to designate a safe path for pedestrians between the buildings.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this sensitive institutional zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and trash to ensure the full width of the walkway remains accessible.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implementing a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic in this residential environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Policy
interventions.description: Implement and enforce regulations to keep sidewalks clear of trash receptacles and private debris to ensure an unobstructed path of travel.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furnishings
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone with street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Paving
interventions.description: Pave the walkway on the left side to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant, and debris-free pedestrian surface.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Add a consistent row of street trees to provide a vertical buffer for pedestrians and naturally calm traffic through visual narrowing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during dawn, dusk, and nighttime.

interventions.title: Physical traffic calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or raised tables to physically enforce lower vehicle speeds in this residential and school zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to remove cracks and vegetation, ensuring a smooth, accessible walking surface.
